# Cookbook

Each page here solves one recognizable problem. Open the page whose problem is yours, copy its template, wire what it names, and run it.

A **recipe** composes rimsky primitives into a working graph for one problem shape. A **journey** takes you from nothing to a running deployment, or from a symptom to a cause.

Recipes point at the examples in `docs/examples/` for the individual behaviors they use. An example shows one behavior on its own; a recipe shows how several compose, and names the shape's sharp edges.

## Recipes

| Recipe | The problem |
| --- | --- |
| [Queue worker](queue-worker.md) | Work arrives in a store and one node should take the next item, process it, and pop it. |
| [Fan out over a store](fan-out-over-a-store.md) | One claim holds many items and each item should get its own dispatch, in parallel. |
| [Park and resume against a rate-limited upstream](park-and-resume.md) | The upstream answers 429 and the node should wait out the limit instead of failing. |
| [Claim handoff across nodes](claim-handoff.md) | Several nodes should work on one acquisition, and the acquisition should resolve once at the end. |
| [Error routing](error-routing.md) | Different failures deserve different answers: retry one, give up on another, ignore a third. |
| [Iterative convergence](iterative-convergence.md) | A node should run again on its own output until a declared condition holds. |
| [Sub-graph delegation](sub-graph-delegation.md) | A step is really a whole graph, and the caller should settle when that graph settles. |
| [Message-driven wake](message-driven-wake.md) | Work should start when something outside the graph happens — a schedule, a webhook, a poll. |

## Journeys

| Journey | Where it takes you |
| --- | --- |
| [Zero-config all-in-one](journey-zero-config.md) | From an empty machine to a node at `terminal/success`. |
| [Split roles with Postgres](journey-split-roles-postgres.md) | From an empty network to three role containers over one Postgres database. |
| [Diagnosing a stuck instance](journey-stuck-instance.md) | From "it never finishes" to the run that is holding everything. |
| [Diagnosing a stale node](journey-stale-node.md) | From "it did not re-run" to the edge, marker, or mode that stopped it. |

## What every page assumes

You have a rimsky deployment and the `rimsky` CLI can reach it. If you do not, start with [Zero-config all-in-one](journey-zero-config.md).

Templates are written in YAML unless the page says otherwise. One key cannot be written in YAML at all — `publishers[].config` — and [Message-driven wake](message-driven-wake.md) explains what to do instead.
